text.en:
Appropriation of funds. The following sums or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation of the
government of the Republic of the Philippines during the period from July first, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and seventy four except where otherwise specifically

Effective date. This Decree which shall take effect on July first, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three, except where otherwise provided, shall form part of the Law of the land.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
